f5b_t_melt_a.hint: Subtract the two lines: GHSERA cancels and 12000 - 10*T is left. Set it to zero.

f5b_g_fcc_a_1000.hint: Use only the range of GHSERA whose limits enclose 1000 K (the one that starts at 900 K); LN is the natural logarithm. The other range gives a close but wrong value.

f5b_gm_03.hint: Reference line 0.7 G_A + 0.3 G_B, plus R T (0.7 ln 0.7 + 0.3 ln 0.3) with R = 8.3145, plus the excess; all at 1000 K.

f5b_atoms_bcc.hint: Count the sites that hold atoms: the three interstitial sites hold vacancies, which are not atoms.

f5b_g_a3b_atoms.hint: The parameter 3 GHSERA + GHSERB - 30000 + 6 T is per formula unit A3B1, which holds four atoms. Divide by the atoms per formula unit.

f5b_asym_flip.hint: x_A x_B = 0.1875 at both compositions; the factor (x_A - x_B) is +0.5 at x_B = 0.25 and -0.5 at x_B = 0.75. Subtract the two excess values.

f5b_l1_sign.hint: Look at the sign of your asymmetry: a positive value means the excess is larger on the A-rich side.

f5b_gmag_600.hint: tau = 600/800 is below 1, so use the first branch of g; A = 518/1125 + 11692/15975 (1/p - 1) with p = 0.28; then R T ln(BMAGN + 1) g(tau) with R = 8.3145.
